collar.candidate_factor: one irreducible factor q of a nonzero actual normal minor of order 1 through 4
collar.saturating_product: u=product of all other distinct nonstructural minor factors, all prescribed nonzero parent brackets, and chart units
collar.claimed_consequence_if_verified: smooth local simultaneous sign collar only

actual_exclusive_pair.scope: fixed actual proper incomparable triple rho_0,rho_1,rho_2 on a normalized parent chart
parent_generators: h_l(x)*e_l^2-1 for all prescribed strict parent/chart inequalities
actual_exclusive_pair.E_ij: parent equations and bad blocks i,j and good block k
actual_exclusive_pair.T: parent equations and all three bad blocks
actual_exclusive_pair.real_scope: exact membership encoding over R; zero weights retained
actual_exclusive_pair.complex_scope: squares do not preserve real signs over C; complex emptiness would be only a sufficient stronger exclusion

mixed_prism.given_input_required: an actual proposed polynomial family P on the full source and its prescribed relative boundary
failure_generators: h_l(P(t))=0 on faces required to remain strict
mixed_prism.missing_input: no full original-domain prism map P with prescribed seams is available

critical.given_input_required: a smooth stratum F=0 of specified full Jacobian rank and a proper chosen function ell
critical.unit_scope: only a specified nonzero full-rank Jacobian minor, on its chart branch
critical.missing_input: no noncircular implication from this critical exclusion to nonzero original signed detector trace
